verdict.rationale: Typesense documents an official, first-party hosted MCP server for Typesense Cloud (https://cloud.typesense.org/mcp/v1, with a `claude mcp add` command). Through it an agent can create and configure clusters, build collections, index data, tune search and read metrics, with user-scoped permissions and the option to disconnect at any time. The docs also reference a "Typesense for AI Agents" guide. missing for 10: explicit evidence that the MCP exposes search queries as a tool (only tuning is mentioned), evidence of search-analytics tools beyond generic metrics, MCP or tool-calling coverage for self-hosted open-source deployments, independent or hands-on corroboration.
